jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Employment Law Leaning (Mat Cover)
jobs.descriptionPlain:
ABOUT PLEO

Company spending is often a mess of receipts, reminders and spreadsheets, and nobody enjoys it, least of all finance. Pleo sets out to fix that. Our tools make paying for things at work simple for employees and give finance teams a clear, live view of where the money goes.

Our name hints at doing a bit more than people expect, and that idea has guided us for a decade.

We are at an important stage: each decision touches our many customers and the whole company. We want people who dig into what customers need, make hard things simple, question habits politely and aim high. We have not figured everything out, and that is part of the fun. We are a friendly, ambitious team of many nationalities, building the future of business spending together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an interim In-house Legal Counsel for our Legal team in Copenhagen, Denmark. You will advise colleagues across the company, protect our interests and help us grow as a fintech. If you like turning legal strategy into everyday practice and want to help build a well-run, compliant company, this could be for you!

Please note that the role covers a parental leave and is fixed-term until 30 September 2027.




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You will report to an Associate Director, Legal and work with People, Fraud, Finance, Product, Compliance and Operations. The legal team works closely together to manage risk while keeping the business moving.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an In-house Legal Counsel, you will:

 - Answer legal questions from every department with quick, practical advice on day-to-day matters.

 - Support the People team on employment law, policies and labour compliance, from contracts to policy drafting in several countries.

 - Draft, review and update internal policies, procedures and legal templates the business can reuse.

 - Help handle fraud and compliance cases with liability assessments, checks and advice on reducing risk.

 - Help with customer complaints and contact with the UK Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS), preparing responses and keeping to deadlines.




WHAT YOU BRING

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A Cand.Jur or equivalent legal qualification recognised in Denmark.

 - 2-5 years of legal work, ideally in fintech, financial services or a fast-growing company with varied matters.

 - Knowledge of employment law and HR compliance across more than one country.

 - Good contract skills: you review, negotiate and draft commercial agreements quickly.

 - Clear communication that turns legal detail into practical advice.

 - A proactive attitude and the ability to juggle several priorities at once.

 - Experience with compliance and risk in a regulated industry, and with regulators or ombudsman services, is a plus.
   
   


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You want to see how law works in practice, applying and explaining it rather than debating it

 - You want a real say in decisions, weighing the legally correct answer against what works commercially

 - You like leaving things behind that last: templates, policies and processes in use long after you leave

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You want a tidy plan. The team is stretched and busy, so expect more urgent work than planned work

 - You want a permanent job. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract covering parental leave

 - You want to specialise or manage. This is a broad, hands-on role with support, not a lead role
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first three months at Pleo, you'll:

 - Take over the routine employment work so it runs without your manager

 - Learn the business well enough that your advice fits how Pleo really works

 - Start shaping the policies and templates a growing company needs

Over the 12 months you will gain in-house experience and a working knowledge of fintech rules that is hard to find elsewhere, with close support from an experienced lead.




THE LOCATION

This is a hybrid role, with on average 3 days a week in our Copenhagen office.




SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

💳 A Pleo card of your own, so no more paying out of pocket

🍜 Lunch on office days, catered or as an allowance depending on the office

🏥 Private health insurance, with the provider depending on your country

🌴 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 Hybrid or fully remote working, depending on the team

🏖️ The option to buy 5 extra days of holiday

❤️‍🩹 Free access to mental health and well-being support

👶 Paid parental leave, because family should not have to wait for work



THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

If your application goes through, this is what follows:

 1. Intro call (30 minutes) – a talk with our talent team about the role, your background and what you want next.

 2. Interview with the Associate Director, Legal (45 minutes) – how you would support the business and how you think about compliance.

 3. Final round with the Associate Director and General Counsel (60 minutes) – real cases you have handled and how you solve problems in-house.





We like to be open about what we look for, so here are a few tips:

 - Your CV: we see many generic, AI-written CVs. Using AI is fine, but tell us the concrete results only you can describe, and link to the companies you worked for.

 - Care: a person reads every application, so please answer the application questions with care. They matter.

 - Fit: point out what in your background matches the role, and anything that might be misread.


ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - English first. English is our company language, so please apply in English. You will use it every day if you join.

 - Every application is read. Our talent team looks at each one to keep things fair, and we only take applications through our system, not by phone or email.

 - Diversity matters. Our team should look like the world we serve, so please apply even if you do not meet every point.

 - Tell us what you need. If you need an adjustment or a different format during the process, write to kontakt@example.com and we will arrange it.

 - Your data. We process your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy at https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

 - Several roles? You are welcome to apply to more than one. We look at each separately, so explain why each one fits you.

 - Applying again? Please wait six months after our last decision before reapplying to the same role.
